data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 CONFLICT_RESOLUTION (Stage 3 Safety/TDD strict_vs_flexible): TDD requirement prevails because this story's purpose IS establishing the contract — warn-only mode would defeat the guard at the moment it ships. Compromise: add config-gated mode parameter with default DSO_DSO_ID_GUARD_MODE='raise'. Override DSO_DSO_ID_GUARD_MODE='warn' available for staged rollout if production migration uncovers missed authorized paths. Tests assert default RAISE mode (RED test passes with raise; warn-mode override is config-only with structured warning log).
